hair_tips: the hair has jagged, torn-looking or messy clump tips and edges
hair_flat: the hair is a flat, evenly lit mass with few or no shadow shapes
hair_bulky: the hair silhouette is bulky and round, like a helmet
hair_short: the hair is too short, exposing too much of the forehead, temples or ears
hair_colour: the hair colour is too orange, too yellow or too light
hair_patches: the hair shows odd patches, overlapping slivers, gaps or holes
hair_noisy: the hair has noisy little marks or scratches
fringe: the fringe looks unnatural over the forehead and brows
ears: the ears look odd or too exposed
head_wide: the head or face looks wider or rounder
face_plain: the face looks plainer or less framed by the hair
outline: the outlines look broken, uneven or too thick
cranium_small: the cranium (top and back of the head with the hair) looks too small or flat for the face
back_flat: the back of the head looks flat, cut off or oddly shaped
forehead_big: the forehead looks too high or too large
face_long: the face looks longer or the jaw heavier
hairline_odd: the hairline or the hair edge around the face looks odd
